verdicts.reason: A: the two-column layout (book left, copy right) suits the format and the headline leads. But the Inkwell & Lantern logo is shrunk to an unreadable smudge on the busy confetti strip. The '24 HOURS, 24 READERS' eyebrow has dropped below the body copy, and the body copy is as big as a subhead. The legal line leaves 'fund.' orphaned on its own line. B: the reading order is inverted, with the 'See the Schedule' CTA jammed against the top edge above the book and headline. The book is shrunk to a tiny icon, and the eyebrow is pushed below the body copy at a size that competes with the headline. The logo is an illegible speck in the bottom-left corner, and most of the confetti is gone, so the original's feel is lost.
